## Summary
What risk, component, or security requirement does this PR address?

## Scope
Affected components, files, privileges, release branches, and explicitly excluded work.

## Security classification
Public hardening | Security fix | Dependency update | Policy/docs

## Threat model
Attacker capability, affected assets, trust boundary, and assumptions.

## Upstream study
Upstream research and reference study.

## What SigmaOS adopts
Adopted patterns and abstractions.

## Kernel component
Kernel changes if applicable.

## Shell component
Shell changes if applicable.

## Kernel safety review
Kernel safety guarantees and invariants.

## Shell safety review
Shell safety guarantees and invariants.

## Impact and versions
Affected configurations/releases, exploitability rationale, and known mitigations.

## Implementation
Why this fix/feature is appropriate; compatibility/API impact; backport considerations.

## Tests and evidence
Regression test, fuzz/property tests, static analysis, integration/runtime results, commands run.

## Safety and rollback
Risks, failure scenarios, and rollback procedure.

## Disclosure and release
Private report reference (if applicable), coordination status, advisory/release plan.

## Checklist
- [ ] Minimal, reviewable change
- [ ] Security tests or regression tests added
- [ ] No secrets or exploit details exposed publicly
- [ ] Docs and component status updated
- [ ] CI passes and review conversations resolved
- [ ] Backport/recovery plan recorded where relevant
- [ ] Reviewer checklist completed
